node.statement: Let C=conv W and d_j=dist_1(p_j,C). By def-invisible-mass applied to row v, sigma=sum_{d_j>0} max(P_vj,0). By the root statement definition of the halo-robust invisible mass, sigma_g=sum_{d_j>tau/4} max(P_vj,0), with tau=sqrt(delta). Since delta>0, tau/4>0, so every index with d_j>tau/4 also has d_j>0. All terms max(P_vj,0) are nonnegative; hence sigma_g<=sigma and sigma-sigma_g>=0. This proves the needed nonnegative factor without using node 1.2.
